display_name: 三个冻结恢复器共享推理的源域逐位验证与计时
description: 同一批合法源 IQ 上比较三个已冻结模型的独立和共享 DURA、分类器计算；不读取 TX 标签、V 或目标。
authorization: 用户继续授权研发星地恢复网络；仅源域合法 IQ 诊断，不重启已停止任务。

code.environment: N607 CPU FP32 TF32 off, 2 threads, batch 8; CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES empty

data.contract_ref: docs/PROJECT_PROTOCOL.md: 恢复器主测试口径及源数据权限
data.physical_ids_ref: 112 fixed source pilot IDs, eight for each receiver group and view, read indices/rx/scene/split only

roles.L_s: source IQ pair, no TX identity
roles.U_s: source IQ pair, TX identity hidden

data.validation_ref: Previously explored fixed source pilot; RX8 is source held group, not independent to DURA

permissions.claim_scope: Frozen F source-only timing and exact-tensor equivalence; not target-wide identity or end-to-end parallel benchmark

checkpoint.initialization: Original DURA, frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL classifier and three separately frozen source-only correction models
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: ground.load_fixed verifies each source checkpoint and frozen model; common DURA and F weights are compared byte by byte
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Frozen Phase1 matching F and three matching source-only correction models; target labels absent
checkpoint.selection_rule: All three already frozen candidates, no target result selection

execution.gpu_policy: CPU only, 2 threads, no GPU worker; preserve all existing owners
execution.stop_rule: Stop on source role mismatch, non-identical frozen weights or outputs, non-finite outputs, technical failure or any target/TX truth access; preserve all other owners.

expected_artifacts: result.json source-only exact tensor comparisons and sequential timing

metric_names: bitwise identical DURA contexts and outputs, classifier logits
independent and shared serial wall time
dimensions: 112 source IQ records: 8 each for two RX groups and seven views

rows.method: Same inputs, batch8 and CPU, compare three independent frozen forwards with one shared DURA and classifier raw/anchor forwards
rows.purpose: Assess exact source equivalence and sequential speedup without changing live predictions
rows.seed_notes: Existing pretrained source runs and fixed source pilots; no stochastic training, support or augmentation in this benchmark.
rows.budget_ref: 112 source IQ records, batch 8; first batch real-checkpoint smoke

notes: Frozen F is used only for source prediction after all models are fixed. No model training or TX labels.
Source bitwise equality cannot establish target-wide output equivalence, nor actual parallel throughput.
Does not interrupt or alter live ground test processes.
